whyMatters.en: Glasgow post-rock band formed in 1995. Young Team (1997, Chemikal Underground) and later film scores made quiet-loud instrumental dynamics a UK festival and soundtrack practice.
whyMatters.zh: 格拉斯哥 post-rock 乐队，1995 年成立。《Young Team》（1997，Chemikal Underground）与后期电影配乐，把强弱器乐动态做成英国音乐节与影视配乐做法。

shortBio.en: Scottish crescendo rock; Auto Rock shows piano-led build without vocals.
shortBio.zh: 苏格兰渐强摇滚；《Auto Rock》展示无人声的钢琴导向推进。

body.en:
Mogwai formed in Glasgow in 1995. Early Chemikal Underground and Matador records use volume as structure—long clean passages, sudden 失真 walls, occasional spoken samples.

Auto Rock (2006, from Mr Beast) is a compact piano-to-swell example. They work parallel to Explosions in the Sky and Godspeed You! Black Emperor, with drier Scottish indie infrastructure and heavy soundtrack commissions (including Zidane and The French Dispatch).
body.zh:
Mogwai 于 1995 年在格拉斯哥成立。早期 Chemikal Underground 与 Matador 唱片把音量当结构——长段干净段落、突然的 失真 墙、偶尔口语采样。

《Auto Rock》（2006，出自《Mr Beast》）是钢琴到 swell 的紧凑例子。与 Explosions in the Sky、Godspeed You! Black Emperor 并行，苏格兰 indie 基建更干，影视委托更多（含《Zidane》与《The French Dispatch》）。

body.en:
Mogwai codified quiet-loud instrumental post-rock in UK indie: few vocals, crescendo as the main event.

Young Team (1997, Chemikal) opens with Mogwai Fear Satan’s 16-minute arc.

Glasgow ties to Chemikal Underground peers; Matador’s US release widened the audience. Later scores for Zidane and The French Dispatch carry the same dynamic writing into film.
body.zh:
Mogwai 在英国 indie 里定下强弱器乐 post-rock：少人声，crescendo 作主事件。

《Young Team》（1997，Chemikal）以《Mogwai Fear Satan》16 分钟弧线开场。

格拉斯哥连 Chemikal Underground 同辈；Matador 美国发行扩大听众。后期《Zidane》《The French Dispatch》配乐把同一动态写法带进电影。

title.en: Classic five through Hardcore Will Never Die
title.zh: Hardcore Will Never Die 前经典五人

body.en:
1995–2016 core: Braithwaite, Cummings, Aitchison, Bulloch, Burns—dual guitar plus keys for harmonic lift.

Cummings exits 2015; Bulloch steps back 2016—later tours use expanded or reduced lineups.

Barry Burns’s piano and synth lines define Auto Rock and later records. Live shows run loud; volume shifts are the performance.
body.zh:
1995–2016 核心：Braithwaite、Cummings、Aitchison、Bulloch、Burns——双吉他加键盘抬和声。

Cummings 2015 年离队；Bulloch 2016 年退——后期巡演用扩展或缩减编制。

Barry Burns 的钢琴与合成器线定义《Auto Rock》与后期唱片。现场很响；音量切换即演出本身。

body.en:
Mogwai’s crescendo writing influenced US and European instrumental bands through 2000s festivals.

Sonic Youth’s tunings and My Bloody Valentine’s 延音 are guitar ancestors; Mogwai simplifies toward volume arcs.

Explosions in the Sky and Godspeed share the map; Mogwai keeps Chemikal indie dryness. Soundtrack work placed post-rock outside rock clubs.
body.zh:
Mogwai 的 crescendo 写法经 2000 年代音乐节影响欧美器乐乐队。

Sonic Youth 定弦与 My Bloody Valentine 的 延音 是吉他祖先；Mogwai 简化为音量弧线。

Explosions in the Sky 与 Godspeed 共享地图；Mogwai 保持 Chemikal indie 干度。配乐工作把 post-rock 放到摇滚俱乐部之外。
